scope: Exact canary source case and contextual occurrences of its existing source ID only; no other campaign case is marked reviewed.
authorship_limits: Primary-source research input for root curation decision, not the independent skeptical review or a native MIM owner review.
reasoning: The frozen source row is traceable exactly to JCM935 via MediaDive J935 solution4947 order12. JCM explicitly identifies a 10% (w/v) BD-Difco yeast-extract stock, but the shared blank MediaDive ID1944 also denotes a Trypticase stock and MES stock in current and frozen source data. Therefore the source ID cannot safely denote a single substance, and no global ID-to-MIM owner or alias is justified.

preparation_interpretation.description: 5 ml of 10% (w/v) yeast-extract solution, BD-Difco, added from an anaerobic stock

correction_ownership: MediaDive source curation/import must repair blank ingredient1944 and its recipe row associations without relabeling all uses as yeast extract. The precise MediaDive parser implementation was not inspected, so the stage that introduced the defect is not established.

A downstream KG source transform or content-bound recipe disposition may preserve/quarantine malformed ID1944 and bind any correction to medium+solution+recipe_order+raw-content hash, if its supported contract permits. Never add a global 1944-to-yeast-extract substitution.

MIM is not the owner of the broken source identifier. New aliases or ingredient records require separately reviewed stable material identity and complete stock scope; source data repair does not itself authorize them.
settling_requirement: An authoritative source correction must separate J935/4947/order12 yeast-extract stock, J935/4947/order13 Trypticase stock, and J1053/5115/order13 MES stock, preserving original source provenance and stock concentrations. To propose any stock/product-specific MIM owner, obtain a stable unambiguous identifier and the complete supplied preparation/product specification (including catalogue identity where product-specific claims require it). JCM already settles the recipe-row intent; generic yeast-extract ontology/supplier identity cannot settle the shared source ID.
no_change_reason: No single substance identity can be assigned to the reused blank source ID1944. Neither an alias to generic yeast extract nor a new stock record would repair all source occurrences safely.
